propositions: Tickets must pass a separately-attested plan-review gate at close time to prevent closing after plan or pinned dependencies changed during execution without re-running implementation from scratch

The close gate accepts certified reviews despite code/file-dependency drift (only CLOSE profile disables code freshness) but blocks unsigned, reopened, registry-stale, material-drift, malformed metadata, and phase-incompatible reviews

The gate runs as a pure local pre_status_check callback inside the existing transaction lock after structural checks but before STATUS append, and fails closed without model/network calls on any unexpected exception

Pin enforcement controls only whether pin health invalidates; all other validity checks (signature, reopen, registry, own-material, phase compatibility, malformed metadata) remain active regardless of pin-enforcement setting
Existing exemptions (bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, idea→closed) and force-close bypass are preserved; structural child-closure rules are never bypassed
The feature is default-off (require_plan_review_for_close=false); existing close paths perform zero plan-review reads and remain byte-for-byte equivalent when disabled
